finding: Cyber and resilience: DR restore testing has excluded the main customer platform for 18 months and privileged access is shared across 14 administrator accounts
why_it_matters: A prolonged outage or breach could trigger customer credits and indemnity claims while insurance cover may not respond

finding: Infrastructure and cloud: 38 percent of production workloads sit on end-of-support infrastructure with no validated cloud exit plan and 14 months of forecast dual-running
why_it_matters: Remediation and dual-running could add cost and delay the synergy case against a GBP 150m enterprise value

finding: Applications and product health: the core product has 11 unsupported components and two undocumented interfaces while 28 percent of engineering capacity is consumed by defect remediation
why_it_matters: Remediation competes with roadmap delivery and could delay revenue and integration milestones

finding: Vendors and contracts: the top three vendors account for 54 percent of run cost and two contracts auto-renew within nine months with above-market uplifts
why_it_matters: Limited leverage and automatic renewals lock in cost leakage after completion

finding: Data: customer and product data are duplicated across three platforms with no enterprise lineage and inconsistent retention controls
why_it_matters: Migration complexity and privacy exposure could require remediation before product and analytics integration
